html:
Hello Sustainable Food Enthusiasts!


Today, I'm excited to share a recipe that not only tantalizes the taste buds but also champions sustainability – presenting the Green Goddess Bowl. Packed with vibrant flavors and nutrient-rich ingredients, this bowl is a celebration of conscious eating and mindful sourcing.


Ingredients:


For the Base:

  • 1 cup quinoa, rinsed

  • 2 cups water

  • A pinch of salt

For the Green Goodness:

  • 2 cups kale, chopped

  • 1 cup broccoli florets

  • 1 avocado, sliced

  • 1 cucumber thinly sliced

  • 1 cup edamame beans, shelled

For the Tangy Tahini Dressing:

  • 3 tablespoons tahini

  • 2 tablespoons olive oil

  • 2 tablespoons lemon juice

  • 1 clove garlic, minced

  • Salt and pepper to taste

  • A dash of water to thin, if needed

  2. Prepare the Greens:

  3. Assemble the Bowl:

  4. Make the Tahini Dressing:

Drizzle and Enjoy:

Drizzle the tangy tahini dressing over the bowl, allowing the flavors to mingle. Toss gently to coat everything in this green goodness.


Sustainability Tips:

  • Opt for organic and locally sourced produce to support sustainable farming practices.

  • Choose quinoa from brands that emphasize ethical sourcing.

  • Use a reusable bowl and utensils to minimize single-use plastic waste.


This Green Goddess Bowl is not only a feast for your taste buds but also a celebration of sustainable and nourishing choices. Enjoy this delicious journey to a greener, healthier lifestyle!


Happy eating,

Orlando Chimankpa
